card.fact_statement: Thousands of SES crews worked to rescue people trapped in floodwaters during the 2025 New South Wales floods.
card.source_span: Thousands of SES crews worked to rescue people who were trapped in the floodwaters.

target_qa_variants.question: Ni nani waliofanya kazi kwa maelfu kuokoa watu walionaswa kwenye maji ya mafuriko wakati wa mafuriko ya New South Wales ya 2025?
target_qa_variants.source_span: Thousands of SES crews worked to rescue people who were trapped in the floodwaters.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'SES crews' to 'Vikosi vya SES' (SES forces/crews).
